name: Protégé
notes: A revelatory tasting menu in an understated room. The duck with cherry jus may haunt us forever.

name: The Village Pub
notes: A Woodside institution with impeccable service. The burger is an insult to how good everything else is.

name: Evvia
notes: Wood-fired everything. The lamb chops were exactly what summer called for.

name: Madera
notes: Rosewood hotel dining done right. The wine list deserved its own evening.

name: Chez TJ
notes: Victorian house, Michelin star, and a truffle course that made everyone go quiet.

name: Navio
notes: Cliffs, fog, and the best Dungeness crab bisque anyone at the table had ever tasted.

name: Selby's
notes: Elegant, confident cooking. The wagyu tartare with black truffle was the opening move of a very good evening.
